name: search_bytes
title: Search for Byte Pattern
description: Searches the currently selected data source for a byte pattern and returns the addresses of all matches. The pattern can be given as a hex string (e.g. 'DEADBEEF') or as an ASCII string.

pattern.description: Pattern to search for, interpreted according to 'type'

type.description: How to interpret the pattern string

end_address.description: Address to stop searching at. Defaults to the end of the data source

max_results.description: Maximum number of matches to return (up to 10000)

handle.description: Handle of the data source that was searched

truncated.description: Whether the search stopped early because max_results was reached
